purpose: Durable cross-chat handoff state for ChatGPT-assisted OVMS Agent development. Read this file first in a new chat, then verify live GitHub branch/issue state before acting.

user_rules.agent_prompt_prefix: When giving lines to paste into OVMS Agent, omit the OVMS-AGENT> prompt prefix.
user_rules.vax_external_identifier_limit: Treat DEC C/VAX 31-character external identifier limit as hard. Audit every newly introduced externally visible function/global/linker-visible symbol before packaging every milestone/fix.
user_rules.vax_c_compatibility: Avoid implicit function declarations and non-C89 constructs in VAX-facing C.
user_rules.github_source_of_truth: Use connected GitHub as source of truth for committed repository files, searches, branches, diffs, issues, PRs, comments, and history. Ask user for OpenVMS commands only for runtime/build/RMS/DCL/live acceptance evidence GitHub cannot provide.
user_rules.project_isolation: Do not mix OVMS Agent build architecture with VMSBBS or other projects.

accepted_milestones.M265: GAP-008 RMS-aware guarded Git restore, including post-merge RMS record-format correction

m265.vax_symbol_limit_status: 20 characters, <=31; corrective PR adds no production linker-visible symbols.
m265.initial_acceptance: Guarded restore created a new highest RMS version, preserved prior versions, restored Git HEAD as effective, and honored workspace approval/write gate.

post_merge_defect.discovery: Native git pull to merged main failed on TEST/GAP008_RMS.TXT with file exists. Recovery advanced HEAD/index via git reset --mixed --no-refresh, then used GITRESTORE on incoming files.
post_merge_defect.failure: GITRESTORE of BUILD_OPENAI_MODULES.COM and openai_modules.opt created 0KB effective files; subsequent @BUILD failed with 136 undefined linker symbols.
post_merge_defect.root_cause: rms_replace_text_file used bare creat(path,0) for existing non-stream .OPT/.COM/.CLD files instead of explicit OpenVMS variable-record/carriage-control attributes.
post_merge_defect.fix: Corrective PR #29 uses creat(path,0,"rat=cr","rfm=var") for the non-stream control-file replacement path.
post_merge_defect.recovery: Known-good historical Stream_LF versions of BUILD_OPENAI_MODULES.COM and openai_modules.opt were copied forward with destination trailing semicolon; @BUILD then passed and Git was clean.

m266.scope: Saved-plan file_count and file-scope persistence for existing and planned-new files, zero-file handling, fail-closed malformed/unsafe scope, focused regression, and RMS Git capture hardening discovered during acceptance.

acceptance.full_build: PASS: @BUILD reported All regression tests passed and Build completed successfully; BUILD_STATUS=%X00000001.

acceptance.negative_case: Expected malformed/ambiguous/stale warning is emitted by deliberate unsafe ../BAD.TXT test and is part of passing coverage.
acceptance.vax_symbols: No new production linker-visible symbols from GAP-009 helpers; helpers are static. Existing git_rms_restore_head remains <=31 characters.

git_restore_hardening.discovery: OpenVMS Git `git show HEAD:TEST_M266_PLAN_SCOPE.COM` failed with no such device or address even though `git cat-file -s` reported a 1551-byte blob. Old GITRESTORE captured zero bytes and falsely verified an empty restored file.
git_restore_hardening.fix: GIT_RMS_RESTORE.C now captures Git content with `git cat-file -p` and independently verifies expected blob size with `git cat-file -s`, preventing empty-capture false success for nonempty blobs.
git_restore_hardening.live_result: PASS: rebuilt agent restored TEST_M266_PLAN_SCOPE.COM as nonzero Variable-length RMS file with carriage-return carriage control and complete expected procedure contents.

m266.github_diff: PR #30 merged with 7 changed files, +802/-78. Temporary repair fixture changes were retained as modernization to current structured replace_block form.

separate_findings: Native Git checkout/pull on this OpenVMS Git build can still fail on RMS-versioned paths; safe recovery uses git fetch plus git reset --mixed --no-refresh followed by guarded GITRESTORE for affected tracked files.

Native Git cannot reliably hash some Variable-record OpenVMS files; after M266 acceptance git diff on TEST_M266_PLAN_SCOPE.COM failed with short read/cannot hash even though the effective file contents were correct.
A newly materialized C file can appear mode-only modified (100644 -> 100755) in local Git on OpenVMS despite identical content; use GitHub branch diff as source of truth.
Manual PROJECT.C PATCH has a separate RMS write defect that can create one-character variable records; do not conflate with GAP-007/GAP-008/GAP-009.
Provider/model tool-use capability varies; anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 through Requesty narrated without issuing tools in the M264 workflow.

TEST_M266_PLAN_SCOPE.COM may show M because native Git cannot hash its Variable-record RMS representation.
